from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v not in (0, background) for v in row)]
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0, background) for r in range(len(grid)))]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(marker_rows, marker_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(marker_cols, marker_cols[1:]):
            a, b = grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1]
            c, d = grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]
            row.append(a if a == b == c == d and a not in (0, background) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-55b6c776.py'
p.write_text(source)
# Recreate the demo grid from its marker lattice and regular background/separators.
marks=[[3,3,0,4,4],[3,3,0,4,4],[0,0,0,4,4],[1,1,0,4,4],[1,1,1,4,4],[0,1,1,4,4]]
mr=[4,7,10,13,16,19]; mc=[3,9,15,21,27]
demo=[[2 if r%3!=1 and c not in mc else 0 for c in range(30)] for r in range(30)]
# Horizontal separator rows are zero, with markers at selected crossings.
for r in range(1,30,3):
    demo[r]=[0]*30
for i,r in enumerate(mr):
    for j,c in enumerate(mc): demo[r][c]=marks[i][j]
# Base grid construction is immaterial at separator rows; all other c not in mc are 2.
ns={}
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),ns)
print('demo result:', ns['transform'](demo))
# Recreate test from its background lattice and marker intersections.
tmarks=[[0,6,6,9,9],[0,6,6,9,9],[0,6,6,9,9],[2,2,3,3,0],[2,2,3,3,3],[0,0,3,3,3]]
tmr=[6,10,14,18,22,26]; tmc=[2,5,8,11,14]
test=[[5 if r%4!=2 and c%3!=2 else 0 for c in range(24)] for r in range(29)]
for i,r in enumerate(tmr):
    for j,c in enumerate(tmc): test[r][c]=tmarks[i][j]
print('test result:', ns['transform'](test))
print('saved:',p)
